@dogecoin_empire 🤣 hidden meaning? How about asking if the things we say have ANY meaning. 

My wife will frequently tell me how she interpreted something I’ve said. Then she’ll acknowledge that she knows I love her and knows I didn’t mean that, I meant exactly what was said.
@dogecoin_empire The answer so far is yes. Although we haven’t had sex in decades. But still friends.
